description: This file defines the Resources interface, which represents a collection of Resource objects within a policy framework. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, modifying, removing resources, and serializing the collection to JSON. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package and interacts with other policy and resource classes.

classes.name: Resources
classes.description: A collection interface for Resource objects within a PolicyEntry, supporting creation, access, modification, removal, and JSON serialization of resources.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Resources collection from an iterable of Resource objects or individual Resource instances.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by Resources, specifically supporting only version V_2.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieves a Resource by its resourceType and resourcePath or by ResourceKey, returning an Optional<Resource>.

methods.name: setResource
methods.description: Sets or replaces a Resource in the collection, returning a new Resources instance.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Removes a Resource by resourceType and resourcePath or by ResourceKey, returning a new Resources instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of resources contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the collection contains no resources.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of resources for functional operations.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Resources collection to a JSON object including non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the Resources collection to a JSON object respecting a specified schema version and field selector.
